correctness.rationale: The norm is the maximum of 12 signed real linear facets. For each of x,y,x−y some facet is tight; imposing three facet equalities gives all candidates as faces of P⊂R4 defined by the three unit-ball constraints. The supplied exact quadratic-field checker has 1728 triples, 168 feasible presentations (144 point faces, 24 segments), and 24 distinct admissible endpoints. An independent implementation enumerated all 4-row intersections (468 feasible bases and 132 distinct vertices of P), isolated 24 equilateral endpoints, and independently clipped all triple-lines (168 feasible, 144 points, 24 segments). All 24 points give both output norms sqrt3 to 2.5e−15 numerical tolerance; each segment admits a common attaining signed output facet at both ends. Affine evaluation proves the lower bound on each entire segment, and norm convexity the upper bound, establishing the continuum theorem (not an interpolation guess). The package Q(sqrt3) rational code supplies exact signs and counts; numerical independent replay is corroborative. The explicitly supplied witness x=(sqrt3−1,sqrt3−1), y=(1,sqrt3−2) also satisfies all five norm conditions.
residual_risks: Only this regular twelve-facet normalization and its linear isometric copies, not all polygonal norms.
Independent floating-point polyhedral replay is not itself a certificate for exact irrational identities; bundled rational arithmetic and facet-affine argument supply that link.

value.rationale: The unit equilateral-triangle G_L constant is a natural Banach-plane invariant. An entire non-Hilbert regular dodecagonal plane unexpectedly reproduces both Hilbertian derived lengths on every admissible pair, furnishing a structurally meaningful boundary to any Hilbert-characterization converse. Exact continuum rigidity from a finite facet certificate is nontrivial and independently reusable, rather than a routine Hilbert-space substitution.
residual_risks: Does not classify the entire family of regular 2n-gon norms or all norms with G_L=6.

final_claim: For the specified regular-dodecagonal norm N12, every unit-equilateral pair N(x)=N(y)=N(x−y)=1 has N(x+y)=N(2x−y)=sqrt(3); consequently G_L=6.
